done_when: Every Antigravity worker, read and review turn that Forge starts runs with FORGE_WORKER=1, as Codex and Claude turns do, and a test proves a Forge command run from inside an Antigravity turn sees it
why: Antigravity (Neon) builder runs do not set FORGE_WORKER=1, unlike Codex and Claude runs (codex.py, claude_turn.py, repo.py), so a Neon builder's Forge commands are treated as the coordinator's: on 27 Nov an unmerged branch's background runner woke from a Neon builder's commands and acted on the repo for two hours, and the merged rules that Forge-started chats never approve and that the half-window line is for the coordinator only rely on the same marker.
